title: A quasi-homogeneous Newton-diagram sufficient condition for the real Jacobian conjecture in the plane (Theorem 1.7)
author: Xiuli Cen, Kangnong Hu, Yuzhou Tian
work: A note on sufficient conditions for the real Jacobian conjecture in the plane
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations 2026, No. 12, pp. 1--15; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.12; publisher version
difficulty_reason: The counted theorem is the main result of the article: a quasi-homogeneous generalisation of the Newton-diagram sufficient condition for the real Jacobian conjecture in the plane, in which the higher homogeneous terms of the two scalar polynomials are replaced by higher terms with respect to an arbitrary positive weight exponent. Its complete proof must set up the weighted-degree expansion of the squared-norm Hamiltonian, transfer the hypothesis on the two scalar polynomials into a statement about the vanishing set of the highest weighted part, locate the support of the Bendixson-compactified Hamiltonian vector field with respect to the two coordinate axes and the diagonal, split the argument into the two cases in which the first weight is smaller or larger than the second, and in each case identify the Newton diagram vertices and edges, their types and the associated Hamiltonians, and then verify that no associated Hamiltonian carries a factor of the printed special form. The intermediate lemma, which shows that the ordering of the weights forces the highest homogeneous term and the highest term in one variable into a strict sandwich, is what makes the case analysis work. This weighted Newton-diagram analysis in the qualitative theory of polynomial vector fields is research level work, not a qualification exercise, so the item is graded H3.
